overview_description.description: A1Zap by A1Base is a social networking platform for building and sharing AI-powered applications and interactive experiences. The platform enables students, creators, and teams to create custom mini-apps, tools, utilities, games, and chatbots without traditional programming. Users can distribute these creations through a shared social graph, embedding them directly into group chats, classes, and campus communities. A1Zap focuses on interactive elements that run inside messaging flows rather than static content feeds. The company provides an integrated mobile app and web environment that connect AI helpers with everyday communication. Its tools are used for use cases such as student matchmaking, rental information sharing, and campus utilities. A1Zap positions its network as a social layer where people build practical AI-powered helpers for each other.
